items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: And then I met Ron later at a Wall-to-Wall Bach program at Symphony Space. He sat in with the orchestra. I think he was about 17 or something. So I’ve known him for a while

ctx.x: I happened to work with his father who was a drummer, one of my first club dates in New York, like a wedding or something. And then I met Ron later at a Wall-to-Wall Bach program at Symphony Space. He sat in with the orchestra. I think he was about 17 or something. So I’ve known him for a while, but I haven’t seen him for a while.

Well when I was looking at your resumes etcetera, this thought came into my head that if you haven’t written a book, you should, and I have the title. Are you ready? It goes something like this (it might have to be edited): John Beal, bassist, Baroque to Bach to Bop to Bernstein to Big Band to Broadway, to Big Bird and Belafonte. I couldn’t fit in Philip Glass, it didn’t have the right ring to it.
